verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions automations run "right in your repository" (github-docs-38), so they share the repository's version history. GitHub's pull request workflow provides a documented way to review changes (github-docs-69, github-docs-61), and the cloud agent stages changes on a branch with a reviewable diff before merge (github-docs-26). However, the evidence never explicitly ties versioning or review to automation definitions, and rollback is not documented anywhere. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that workflow/automation definitions are versioned and reviewed via PRs, any documented rollback/revert path for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
